article.introduction: The 50-player BMW Championship field at Bellerive Country Club features a model that weights SG OTT at 1% and SG Total at 3%. Scottie Scheffler (model rank 1, SG Total 868), Rory McIlroy (model rank 2, SG Total 785), and Jake Knapp (model rank 3, SG Total 002) occupy the top three spots. All three players carry zero tracked rounds in the post-Open window and sit inside the top 50 of the FedExCup standings.
